name: Model router
description: Before each message, a small model reads it and says what kind of work it is - code, a picture, reasoning, a long text, or general - and the session switches to the model best for that.
author: mainul35

settings.label: Small model's endpoint (OpenAI-compatible)
settings.help: Where the small model that reads each message is reached. Your AI gateway, or an Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1.

settings.label: API key for that endpoint
settings.help: Your AI gateway key. Leave empty for an endpoint that needs none, such as a local Ollama.

settings.label: Small model
settings.help: Fast and small is the point: it answers one word. The gateway uses qwen3:1.7b for the same job.

settings.label: Model for pictures
settings.help: Used whenever a picture is attached, without asking the small model: it has to be one that sees images.

settings.label: Model for everything else
settings.help: Left on automatic, general questions stay on whichever model is in use: switching costs a model load.

settings.label: Say under each message where it was routed
